criteria.rationale: Inspected CLI, MCP, file schemas and adoption boundaries; unknown obligations are refused, frozen historical inputs remain auditable, and experimental overlays remain opt-in.

Inspected the canonical spec, CLI reference, applicable skills and embedded manual; explicit pending judgments and the implemented contract are consistent. Portuguese auto-approval guidance was corrected in the residual spec.

Inspected bounded errors, freshness and unavailable states; diagnostics identify the next required action without converting unknown evidence into approval. No causal or telemetry benefit is inferred.
Compared attributed implementation and structural observation with the canonical source requirements; changes stay within the declared contract and separately tracked integrity residuals.

Inspected confinement, immutable evidence, identity and authority checks; missing support cannot authorize writes or approve findings. Critical wont-fix and negative-decision reuse bypasses are fixed and covered by Store, CLI and signed-import tests.
